zig_core_tier1.role: Tier-1: Runtime spine, capture, detection, correlation, policy orchestration, control pipe

rust_pep_tier3.role: Tier-3: Policy Enforcement Point + Federation TLS

go_nose.role: Packet acquisition, flow collection, IPC reader, canonical event production

cpp_native_helpers.role: Native Windows adapters: WFP user-mode, ETW helpers, FIM

cpp_bridge.role: C++ IPC bridge: event queue, DEFCON, IPS block/unblock, adapter management
cpp_bridge.build: cd bridge && cmake -B build && cmake --build build

brain_tier2.role: Tier-2: Threat analysis, regex scanning, analytics

ts_policy_compiler.role: Policy authoring, simulation, compilation to Policy IR
ts_policy_compiler.build: cd ts_policy && npm run typecheck && npm run test:all
ts_policy_compiler.note: Advisory only - no build output. Typecheck + test only.

mouth_defcon_gui.role: OPTIONAL standalone DEFCON Security Monitor GUI (log tailing, alert/mitigation feeds, health pipe). Separate operator component - NOT part of the Rust PEP authority and never linked into the runtime.

rust_shield_tier3.role: Tier-3 payload screening / memory-safety shield (sec_monitor.dll), loaded at runtime startup via bridge_init; separate authority from the Rust PEP (rust-src/).

cpp_bridge.produced_by: cd bridge && cmake -B build && cmake --build build

cpp_adapter.produced_by: cd bridge && cmake -B build && cmake --build build

legacy_markers.core/*.zig: RECONNECTED - all src/core modules compile in the test graph (src/tests/core/) and the runtime wiring lives in src/main.zig/daemon.zig via bridge_init; src/ remains the canonical runtime root
legacy_markers.core/nids_main.zig: LEGACY - superseded by src/main.zig + src/daemon.zig (same bridge wiring carried over)
legacy_markers.shield/: RESTORED Tier-3 Rust crate (aegis-shield) - builds shield/target/release/sec_monitor.dll, loaded at runtime by bridge_init; separate authority from rust-src/ (Rust PEP)
legacy_markers.go/: RESTORED - go/aggregator/ is a working Go module (builds and tests green in CI); nose/ remains the Go sensor source
legacy_markers.mouth/build_mouth.bat: LEGACY build path - superseded by mouth/Cargo.toml (rustc-direct build; also references missing aegis_mouth_tui.rs)

invariants: ONE production runtime (Zig core + Rust PEP + Rust Shield + Go Nose + C native helpers + C++ bridge)
src/ = canonical Zig source; src/core/ = reconnected legacy modules (compiled in test graph, wired into runtime)
rust-src/ = canonical Rust PEP source (single PEP authority); shield/ = canonical Tier-3 shield crate (sec_monitor.dll)
bridge/ = canonical C++ bridge, native/ = DOES NOT EXIST
